import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime for easier manipulation
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a pivot table for monthly sales by product
monthly_sales = df.pivot_table(index=df['date'].dt.to_period('M'), 
                               columns='product', 
                               values='total', 
                               aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)

# Reset index for plotting
monthly_sales = monthly_sales.reset_index()
monthly_sales['date'] = monthly_sales['date'].dt.to_timestamp()

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.lineplot(data=monthly_sales, x='date', y='Cappuccino', label='Cappuccino', marker='o')
sns.lineplot(data=monthly_sales, x='date', y='Tea', label='Tea', marker='o')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Monthly Sales Trend by Product')
plt.xlabel('Month')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Product')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime for easier manipulation
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a pivot table for monthly sales by product
monthly_sales = df.pivot_table(index=df['date'].dt.to_period('M'), 
                               columns='product', 
                               values='total', 
                               aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)

# Reset index for plotting
monthly_sales = monthly_sales.reset_index()
monthly_sales['date'] = monthly_sales['date'].dt.to_timestamp()

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.lineplot(data=monthly_sales, x='date', y='Cappuccino', label='Cappuccino', marker='o')
sns.lineplot(data=monthly_sales, x='date', y='Tea', label='Tea', marker='o')

plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
